import openpyxl

print("\\n=== Categorical Column Summaries ===")

    counts = Counter(vals)
    print(f"\\n  {col}:")
    print(f"    Unique values: {len(counts)}")
    for val, cnt in counts.most_common(10):
        print(f"    - {val}: {cnt}")
